stem:
Rina notices that cooked spinach is softer and less bright green than raw spinach.

What is the best conclusion about cooking and nutrients?

options.text: Cooking destroys every mineral in the spinach.
Cooking can change colour and texture and may reduce some nutrients.
Cooked spinach has no nutrients left.
The duller colour proves every nutrient is gone.

teacher.key_rationale: Cooking can change colour and texture and may reduce some nutrients; it does not wipe out all of them.
